crossRefs.note: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is…
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of…
All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of…

translations.web: Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died; and she was left with her two sons.
translations.bsb: Then Naomi’s husband Elimelech died, and she was left with her two sons,
translations.kjv: And Elimelech Naomi's husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.
